name: Universitat Pompeu Fabra
summary: Public university in central Barcelona; eight bachelor's you can take in English, from International Business Economics to data-science engineering.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10). In Catalonia only PAU specific-phase or UNED PCE exams lift it towards 14; IB subject grades on the credential do not count.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in International Business Economics
programmes.about: Economics and business for an international career, with every course taught in English at UPF's Faculty of Economics and Business in central Barcelona.
programmes.overview: The first year gives a base in mathematics, company law and financial accounting, and the second goes deeper into microeconomics, macroeconomics, probability, statistics, econometrics and financial analysis, with later work on international trade, marketing and strategy. Teaching is a weekly mix of lectures and seminars, a study period abroad is compulsory, preferably in an English-speaking country, and an optional internship must be abroad or with an international company. Many credits are optional, so there are no fixed tracks, and a final project closes the degree. Graduates work as international market advisers, business consultants, auditors, sales and marketing directors, or in European and international bodies.
programmes.ib: All courses in English; B2 English is essential, but no English test is required for admission.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Global Studies
programmes.about: Cultural, economic, legal, environmental, political and technological change studied across disciplines, with compulsory study of a further language.
programmes.overview: The degree studies the cultural, economic, legal, environmental, political, social and technological forces of a global society from a transdisciplinary angle, with attention to challenges such as climate change, migration, artificial intelligence, economic crises, war, poverty and pandemics. The first two years are in English, with three compulsory courses in a further language chosen from Chinese, Arabic, Russian, French or Spanish, and later electives can be taken in English, Spanish or Catalan. A stay abroad is compulsory in the third or fourth year, with a double degree option with an Australian university, and optional internships range from government bodies and the European Parliament to think tanks and companies.
programmes.ib: Taught in English in years 1–2; years 3–4 electives run in English, Spanish or Catalan. B2 English advisable.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Technologies and Economic Analysis
programmes.about: Industrial engineering combined with the fundamentals of economics, taught entirely in English jointly by UPF and the Polytechnic University of Catalonia (UPC).
programmes.overview: Industrial engineering subjects and the fundamentals of economics are combined, so you learn how technology and processes work and how businesses and markets respond to them. The programme is shared by two Barcelona universities, taught entirely in English across both campuses, and offers optional extracurricular internships on innovation projects at national and international companies. A third language must also be demonstrated. It leads directly into the master's in industrial engineering that qualifies for the regulated profession, or into advanced economics. Graduates manage projects, plants and technology centres in energy, chemicals, robotics, automotive and rail, or work in strategic planning, quality and environmental management.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering
programmes.about: A science-based computer engineering degree covering areas such as virtual reality, data science, cybersecurity and machine learning.
programmes.overview: A science-based computer engineering curriculum covers the technologies behind everyday applications, including virtual and augmented reality, data science, cybersecurity, machine learning and computational genetics. You can study the whole degree in English, or in a mix of Catalan, Spanish and English, with most third- and fourth-year teaching in English. Optional internships in companies start in the third year, exchanges are open from the third year, a final project closes the degree, and a double degree option is available. Graduates work as cybersecurity experts, web and mobile developers, software and hardware engineers, game developers, tech consultants and IT project managers.
programmes.ib: Choose the 100%-English group in years 1–2 (a Catalan/Spanish group also runs); most later subjects are in English. B2 English highly recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Computational Audiovisual Engineering
programmes.about: Designing and developing audio, video and multimedia systems; formerly Audiovisual Systems Engineering, with a largely shared first year across UPF's ICT degrees.
programmes.overview: The degree trains engineers to design and build audio, video and multimedia systems, weighing cost, quality, security and time in their decisions and keeping the human, legal and ethical sides of the work in view. The first year is largely shared with the other information-technology degrees at the school, and you can take the whole degree in English or in a mix of Catalan, Spanish and English. Optional external internships start in the third year, with companies from broadcasters to technology firms, exchanges are open from the third year, and a final project closes the degree. Graduates work in video and radio production, recording studios, broadcasting, the music, film and video game industries, and computer vision companies.
programmes.ib: Choose the 100%-English group in years 1–2 (a Catalan/Spanish group also runs); most later subjects are in English. B2 English highly recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Network Engineering
programmes.about: Designing, managing and operating networks, protocols and multimedia telecom services, with elective tracks in audiovisual systems, software or business.
programmes.overview: You learn to conceive, design, manage and operate networks, protocols and multimedia telecommunication services, with the aim of making technical decisions on cost, quality, security and time. Elective tracks in audiovisual systems, software engineering, or business management and innovation let you tailor the later years. You can study entirely in English, optional internships with companies start in the third year, exchanges abroad are open from the third year, and a final project closes the degree. Graduates work in network development, mobile applications, cybersecurity, robotics and drones, research centres, multimedia and internet companies, and network operators.
programmes.ib: Choose the 100%-English group in years 1–2 (a Catalan/Spanish group also runs); most later subjects are in English. B2 English highly recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in Mathematical Engineering in Data Science
programmes.about: An engineering profile built on maths and data: analysing large volumes of data from social networks, medicine or smart cities to support decisions.
programmes.overview: The degree is built on mathematics and computing for making sense of the large volumes of data that social networks, personalised medicine, recommendation systems and smart cities produce. The first year is largely shared with the school's other information-technology degrees, which makes a second degree possible with little extra time. You can take the whole degree in English, optional internships start in the third year, exchanges abroad are open from the third year, and a final project closes the degree. Graduates work as data analysts, machine learning specialists, software developers and AI engineers.
programmes.ib: Choose the 100%-English group in years 1–2 (a Catalan/Spanish group also runs); most later subjects are in English. B2 English highly recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment. The cut-off shown is the last admitted grade for 2025-26.

programmes.name: Double Bachelor's Degree: Bachelor of Laws (KCL) + Bachelor Degree in Law (UPF)
programmes.about: English common law and Spanish law in one double degree: years 1–2 at King's College London, years 3–4 at UPF in Barcelona.
programmes.overview: Two legal traditions are studied in one degree: English common law in the first two years in London, then Spanish law in the last two in Barcelona, with two transition modules in Spanish private and criminal law before the main courses. You learn to analyse conflicts, argue and negotiate, interpret sources of law in both systems, and compare how the two work, using legal language in English and in Spanish or Catalan. External internships can be arranged in the third and fourth years in Barcelona. Graduates can follow careers such as lawyer, solicitor, judge, notary, diplomat, international civil servant, legal consultant or NGO adviser, though many of these need further training and national exams.
programmes.ib: Apply through UCAS by 13 January 2027, 18:00 UK time, with the LNAT law test; King's IB entry requirements apply.
programmes.selectionNote: Selected through UCAS on your IB record, the LNAT and a teacher's reference with predicted grades; 15 to 30 places.

notes: If you apply through the EU/IB route you may not apply to UPF by any other route in the same academic year.
The Law double degree with King's College London is applied for through UCAS, by 13 January 2027, not through the Catalan pre-enrolment.
Where a degree runs an English and a Catalan/Spanish group, its places and cut-off cover both groups.
